decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 20 Downs View.
Condition : 5 - The window formed in the flank (eastern) wall shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank (eastern) wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans, the ground floor level of the side and rear elevations shall be finished in brick painted off-white, to match the ground floor level of the side and rear elevations of the main house.  This shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 8 - The proposal, because of its size, design and appearance, is considered acceptable having due regard to the site characteristics and would not harm the appearance of the house or the area as a whole, neighbours' living conditions or traffic movement and the parking provision for the street.  The proposed development therefore complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycling Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan Adopted December 2003 and Council's Residential Extension Guidelines Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of two storey side extension and single storey side extension to house.
